text:
ashley: heads up — we need to finalize the enterprise audit playbook for Q3 launch. focus: immutable event streams + exportable evidence receipts. who owns the launch gates?

devon: i can draft the launch gates. thinking minimal: 1) immutable retention tiers, 2) export SLA (max latency + throttles), 3) key-handshake for customer-managed keys, 4) evidence packaging spec.

a sh: @devon nice. can you add acceptance criteria (tests + smoke)? we should make the rollout non-disruptive.

devon: yep. suggested smoke checks: create export, verify checksum, verify signature from our HSM. quick example command for testing:
```
redwoodctl audit export --tenant T123 --since 2026-03-01 --out sample.ndjson
sha256sum sample.ndjson
redwoodctl audit verify --file sample.ndjson --sig sample.sig
```

ravi: on keys: customers asking for rotation autonomy. we should support a soft-handshake mode: customer-supplied wrapping keys + an escrow fallback for emergency access w/ legal ops.

marta: SOC2/ISO side — we need documented control mappings for each gate. also an evidence retention matrix per region (EU/US/APAC). legal hold override must freeze TTLs and surface alerts to security.

sophia: legal ops here — escrow fallback needs a clear audit trail (who requested, justification, TTL). also need a path for court-ordered data requests. please add to runbook.

ashley: good call. ops runbook should include escalation ladder and a timestamped receipt bucket (immutable) for every escrow op.

ops-bot: deploy job started: deploy/audit-playbook-v1 -> staging (uid: f3a1). status: queued. :gear:

devon: staging deploy succeeded. next: automated acceptance tests against staging with tenant-sim. i'll schedule tomorrow.

ravi: questions for product: do we expose per-tenant export concurrency limits? customers want burst for eDiscovery but not unlimited.

ashley: yes — propose tiered SLAs: basic (1 concurrent export), business (5), enterprise (10) with burst windows. include rate-limit headers in responses.

marta: also require retention proof for SOC2: a daily signed manifest of stored streams so auditors can reconcile. format preference? ndjson manifests or a signed manifest file (jsonl + signature).

devon: i'll standardize on ndjson manifest + detached signature. smaller and easy to stream. will add schema draft.

sophia: finalize legal-hold wording. we need a short customer-facing doc for contract clauses: freeze window, evidence export, KMS responsibilities.

ashley: action items: @devon draft launch gates + ndjson manifest schema, @ravi design soft-handshake key flow + emergency escrow audit trail, @marta map SOC2/ISO controls to gates, @sophia write legal-hold clause draft. we'll review Fri 11am.

devon: noted. aiming for PR by EOD Thu.

ravi: I'll prep a design slide for the soft-handshake and key rotation options.

marta: I'll pull the control mappings from last year's SOC2 report and mark gaps.

sophia: will draft contract language and include sample customer opt-in language.

ashley: thanks all. goal: unblock customer pilots by end of Q3. keep threads tight and post blockers ASAP. :rocket:
